# Car TCO Skill for Muse

Compares the true total cost of ownership — new vs. used vs. leasing vs. keeping your current car — over a real horizon: depreciation, insurance, the maintenance ramp, fuel, with ranked totals, a true monthly cost, an explicit assumption log, and an honest list of what the model does not capture. It ships a deterministic Python script (`scripts/car_tco.py`) so the numbers are reproducible, not vibes. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: defaults are US (12,000 miles/year, $0.14/mile) — but they're explicitly labeled and editable; and this one has no EV model (the author's separate ev-vs-gas skill covers that). Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
